name: Natural Language Coordinate Resolution
description: Translates ambiguous natural language queries into exact spreadsheet coordinates, structural ranges, and specific column headers without explicit technical cell references.

name: Targeted Format & Formula Preservation
description: Performs targeted cell-level modifications that preserve existing fonts, fills, borders, number formatting, formula chains, and VBA macros.

name: High-Performance Statistical Computing
description: Executes advanced descriptive metrics, variance, standard deviation, percentiles, z-scores, rolling averages, and Pearson correlations across spreadsheet ranges.

name: Multi-Sheet Relational Joins
description: Executes in-memory hash joins (inner, left, right, full outer) across multiple worksheets based on key identifiers, generating merged output sheets with aligned schemas.

name: Multi-Dimensional Pivot Table Engine
description: Generates dynamic multi-axis pivot tables with row dimensions, column dimensions, aggregate metrics, hierarchical headers, and grand totals.

name: Transaction Rollbacks & Pre-Save Validation
description: Protects workbook integrity using state-managed transaction logs with multi-step rollbacks, automated error recovery, and pre-save schema validation.
